summary: Regression tested v2.2 batch (tappable schedule-event link chips on Calendar, inline combinable filter chip rows on Schedule/Expenses/Competitions, 'Season Total' rename, multi-link editor on schedule/competition create forms, backend links[] persistence, expenses ascending sort). Both backend (pytest, 7/7) and mobile-web UI (Playwright, 375x667 & 390x844) verified against public preview URL. All targeted flows pass. No deprecated packages introduced by this batch. No React Native red screens. Only unrelated warnings observed: props.pointerEvents/style.tintColor deprecation warnings from Expo/RN internals (pre-existing).
critical_code_review_comments: calendar.py: schedule item spans now include links[] on every day of a multi-day event (line 314). That is correct given links belong to the event itself; but reviewers should be aware every span-day chip will link to the same URLs. Not a bug; noting for awareness.

LinksEditor.tsx cleanLinks(): auto-prepends https:// for URLs missing scheme. Good defensive normalization; ensure calendar tap uses this same string (it does — value stored is already normalized on save).
FilterChipRow.tsx: hides entire row when options.length===0. This is why the empty-state category row correctly disappears when there are no expenses.
Backend POST /api/schedule returns List[ScheduleEvent] due to recurrence expansion — test harness had to be aware.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral schedule event + competition with links created via pytest and via manual Python script for UI verification (title/name prefix TEST_). All rows deleted post-test — verified via cleanup script. One stray 'TEST_sched_links_fd2ac4' from an earlier session was also cleaned.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tab labels in the bottom nav are: Home, Athletes, Expenses, Comps, Schedule, Calendar (not 'Money'/'Competitions'). Direct routes: /athletes, /expenses, /competitions, /schedule, /calendar, /help/faq, /schedule/new, /competitions/new. Login endpoint returns 'access_token' (not 'token'). POST /api/schedule returns List[ScheduleEvent] (recurrence-aware) — always index [0] or handle list. Public URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env. Credentials: applereview@cheerplanner.app / Review2026!.
